message.content: The last common ancestor of a lion (Panthera leo) and a zebra (Equus quagga) is the last common ancestor of all placental mammals (Eutheria). This ancestor lived roughly 100–120 million years ago, before the divergence of the major mammalian orders such as Carnivora (which includes lions) and Perissodactyla (which includes zebras).
